<!--
BRCA and SCAN-B age-matched deviation panels.

Panels produced:
  - GTEx-anchored age vs chronological age, 4 cohorts: GTEx, TCGA-NAT, TCGA-PT, SCAN-B
  - Age-matched deviation by cohort, as boxplots
  - ClockSHAP heatmaps (TCGA-BRCA, SCAN-B), saved separately with shared scales
  - PAM50 deviation by cohort
  - TP53 mutation class vs P53 Pathway phi, PAM50-adjusted, one model per cohort

Some panels may not appear in the published manuscript. Panels are assembled and
typeset in Adobe Illustrator to produce the final figure.

Assumptions:
- The processing, clock, and ClockSHAP steps of the pipeline have been run and
  saved under results/derived/GTEx/<TCGA>__<GTEx>/.
- 06_scanb_processing_BRCA has been run and saved scanb_pathway_inputs.rds
  (ssGSEA scores + coldata). We pick up from that file rather than re-running
  the SCAN-B counts -> logCPM -> ssGSEA pipeline.
-->


```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE
)
set.seed(params$seed)
```

```{r libs}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(tidyr)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(grid)        # unit()
  library(here)

  library(glmnet)      # for predict() on the saved enet model

  library(ClockSHAP)

})
```

# 1 — Load TCGA-BRCA pipeline outputs

```{r load-brca}
tcga_project <- params$tcga_project
gtex_project <- params$gtex_project
feature_set  <- params$feature_set
base_dir     <- params$base_dir

analysis_id  <- paste0(tcga_project, "__", gtex_project)
analysis_dir <- file.path(here::here(base_dir), analysis_id)
suffix       <- paste0("-", feature_set)

clock_rds      <- file.path(analysis_dir, paste0("clock_and_RAA_objects", suffix, ".rds"))
clockshap_rds  <- file.path(analysis_dir, paste0("clockshap_objects",     suffix, ".rds"))
metadata_rds   <- file.path(analysis_dir, "sample_metadata.rds")
scores_gtex_rds <- file.path(analysis_dir, paste0("ssgsea_scores_gtex",  suffix, ".rds"))

stopifnot(
  file.exists(clock_rds),
  file.exists(clockshap_rds),
  file.exists(metadata_rds),
  file.exists(scores_gtex_rds)
)

clock_results    <- readRDS(clock_rds)
clockshap_bundle <- readRDS(clockshap_rds)
metadata         <- readRDS(metadata_rds)
scores_gtex      <- readRDS(scores_gtex_rds)

feat <- clock_results$feature_names
stopifnot(all(feat %in% rownames(scores_gtex)))

# ClockSHAP for TCGA-BRCA primary tumors (already computed and saved by the ClockSHAP step)
cs_brca <- clockshap_bundle$pt
stopifnot(inherits(cs_brca, "clockshap"))

message("TCGA-BRCA features in clock: ", length(feat),
        " | PT samples: ", nrow(cs_brca$phi))
```

# 2 — Fit GTEx reference line (shared anchoring)

We need the GTEx-only fit `pred ~ age` once; both the anchored-age scatter and
the SCAN-B anchored predictions reuse it.

```{r gtex-fit}
pred_gtex <- clock_results$pred$GTEx
age_gtex  <- clock_results$age$GTEx[names(pred_gtex)]

ok_g       <- complete.cases(pred_gtex, age_gtex)
pred_gtex  <- pred_gtex[ok_g]
age_gtex   <- age_gtex[ok_g]
bias_fit <- lm(pred_gtex ~ age_gtex)
beta0    <- coef(bias_fit)[1]
beta1    <- coef(bias_fit)[2]

c(beta0 = unname(beta0), beta1 = unname(beta1), n_gtex = length(pred_gtex))
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
#   Sanity check — deviation consistency
#   For each cs object we have at this point, verify
#       cs$expected  == beta0 + beta1 * cs$age
#       cs$deviation == cs$predicted - (beta0 + beta1 * cs$age)
#   i.e. ClockSHAP's notion of "expected" is the same GTEx line we just fit.
# ============================================================================
check_dev_vs_gtex_line <- function(cs, label, beta0, beta1, tol = 1e-6) {
  stopifnot(all(c("age", "predicted", "expected", "deviation") %in% names(cs)))

  exp_recon <- beta0 + beta1 * cs$age
  dev_recon <- cs$predicted - exp_recon

  d_exp <- max(abs(cs$expected  - exp_recon), na.rm = TRUE)
  d_dev <- max(abs(cs$deviation - dev_recon), na.rm = TRUE)

  message(sprintf(
    "[%-18s] max |expected - GTEx line| = %.3g | max |deviation - (pred - GTEx line)| = %.3g",
    label, d_exp, d_dev
  ))
  invisible(c(d_exp = d_exp, d_dev = d_dev))
}

# Primary tumor (the cs object the downstream panels read from)
chk_pt  <- check_dev_vs_gtex_line(cs_brca, "TCGA-BRCA PT", beta0, beta1)

# Adjacent normal, if present in the bundle (reference group for the cohort boxplots)
chk_nat <- if (!is.null(clockshap_bundle$nat)) {
  check_dev_vs_gtex_line(clockshap_bundle$nat, "TCGA-BRCA NAT", beta0, beta1)
} else {
  message("clockshap_bundle$nat not present — skipping NAT check.")
  c(d_exp = NA_real_, d_dev = NA_real_)
}

stopifnot(chk_pt["d_dev"] < 1e-6)
if (!is.na(chk_nat["d_dev"])) stopifnot(chk_nat["d_dev"] < 1e-6)
```

# 3 — Load SCAN-B pre-processed inputs (ssGSEA + coldata)

The SCAN-B processing script (`06_scanb_processing_BRCA`) already computed and
saved the SCAN-B Hallmark ssGSEA matrix and the relevant coldata (sample_id,
age_years, SSP.PAM50, RFi_days, RFi_event). We pick up from there.

```{r scanb-load-rds}
stopifnot(file.exists(params$scanb_inputs_rds))
scanb_inputs <- readRDS(params$scanb_inputs_rds)

stopifnot(
  is.list(scanb_inputs),
  all(c("ssgsea_scores", "coldata") %in% names(scanb_inputs))
)

scanb_scores_pxs <- scanb_inputs$ssgsea_scores   # pathways x samples
scanb_coldata    <- scanb_inputs$coldata         # data.frame, rownames = sample IDs

stopifnot(all(feat %in% rownames(scanb_scores_pxs)))

message("SCAN-B samples loaded: ", ncol(scanb_scores_pxs))
```

# 4 — Apply BRCA clock to SCAN-B (raw + GTEx-anchored predictions)

```{r scanb-predict}
X_scanb     <- t(scanb_scores_pxs[feat, , drop = FALSE])
scanb_ids   <- rownames(X_scanb)
scanb_age   <- as.numeric(scanb_coldata[scanb_ids, "age_years"])
names(scanb_age) <- scanb_ids

pred_scanb_raw <- as.numeric(predict(
  clock_results$enet_model,
  newx = X_scanb,
  s    = clock_results$tuning$best_lambda
))
names(pred_scanb_raw) <- scanb_ids

scanb_pred_df <- tibble(
  sample_id = scanb_ids,
  age_years = scanb_age[scanb_ids],
  predicted = pred_scanb_raw[scanb_ids]
) %>%
  filter(is.finite(age_years), is.finite(predicted)) %>%
  mutate(
    pred_anchored = predicted - beta0 + (1 - beta1) * age_years,
    dev_gtex      = predicted - (beta0 + beta1 * age_years)
  )
```

# 5 — ClockSHAP on SCAN-B (using the saved BRCA reference + clock)

```{r scanb-clockshap}
clock_cs  <- clockshap_bundle$clock
reference <- clockshap_bundle$reference

ok_scanb     <- is.finite(scanb_pred_df$age_years) & scanb_pred_df$age_years > 0
X_scanb_cs   <- X_scanb[scanb_pred_df$sample_id[ok_scanb], , drop = FALSE]
age_scanb_cs <- scanb_pred_df$age_years[ok_scanb]

cs_scanb <- ClockSHAP::clockshap(
  features  = X_scanb_cs,
  age       = age_scanb_cs,
  clock     = clock_cs,
  reference = reference
)

# Invariant: rowSums(phi) == deviation
inv_max <- max(abs(rowSums(cs_scanb$phi) - cs_scanb$deviation))
message("SCAN-B ClockSHAP invariant max |rowSums(phi) - deviation| = ",
        signif(inv_max, 3))
stopifnot(inv_max < 1e-8)

chk_scanb <- check_dev_vs_gtex_line(cs_scanb, "SCAN-B PT", beta0, beta1)
stopifnot(chk_scanb["d_dev"] < 1e-6)
```

# 6 — Attach TP53 status to SCAN-B (Brueffer 2020 export)

Same deleterious-variant filter as the TCGA pipeline, mapped onto Brueffer's
coarser SnpEff effect classes. Samples *outside* the Brueffer 2020 cohort of
3,217 are left as `NA` (we cannot confidently call WT for them).

```{r scanb-tp53}
scanb_tp53_tsv <- params$scanb_tp53_tsv

if (file.exists(scanb_tp53_tsv)) {

  mut <- readr::read_tsv(
    scanb_tp53_tsv,
    comment        = "##",
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )

  req_cols <- c("SAMPLE", "gene.symbol", "SnpEff.Effect.Class")
  if (!all(req_cols %in% colnames(mut))) {
    warning("SCAN-B mutation TSV missing required columns (need: ",
            paste(req_cols, collapse = ", "),
            "); skipping TP53 attach.")
  } else {

    keep_classes <- c("Missense", "Nonsense", "Frameshift", "Splicing", "In-frame indel")

    tp53_mut_samples <- mut |>
      dplyr::filter(
        gene.symbol == "TP53",
        SnpEff.Effect.Class %in% keep_classes
      ) |>
      dplyr::pull(SAMPLE) |>
      unique()

    cohort_ids <- unique(mut$SAMPLE)

    scanb_ids_full  <- rownames(scanb_coldata)
    scanb_ids_match <- sub("\\.k2\\.a\\.t$", "", scanb_ids_full)

    tp53_vec        <- rep(NA_character_, length(scanb_ids_full))
    names(tp53_vec) <- scanb_ids_full

    in_cohort <- scanb_ids_match %in% cohort_ids
    tp53_vec[in_cohort] <- ifelse(
      scanb_ids_match[in_cohort] %in% tp53_mut_samples, "Mut", "WT"
    )

    scanb_coldata$TP53 <- tp53_vec

    message(
      "SCAN-B TP53 attach: ",
      "Mut=",   sum(tp53_vec == "Mut", na.rm = TRUE),
      " | WT=", sum(tp53_vec == "WT",  na.rm = TRUE),
      " | NA=", sum(is.na(tp53_vec)),
      " (NA = outside Brueffer 2020 cohort of 3,217)"
    )
  }

} else {
  message("SCAN-B TP53 attach skipped (file not found): ", scanb_tp53_tsv)
}
```

```{r out-dir}
out_dir <- here::here(params$fig_dir)
if (isTRUE(params$save_figures)) {
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
}
```

# Anchored predicted age vs chronological age (4 cohorts)

GTEx, TCGA-BRCA NAT, TCGA-BRCA primary tumors, and SCAN-B primary tumors
plotted on the same anchored-age axis (`pred - beta0 + (1 - beta1) * age`).
GTEx is anchored to identity by construction; the vertical displacement of
each tumor cohort from identity is the GTEx-anchored deviation.

```{r panelA-build-df}
# GTEx
gtex_df <- tibble(
  cohort        = "GTEx",
  age_years     = as.numeric(age_gtex),
  pred_anchored = as.numeric(pred_gtex - beta0 + (1 - beta1) * age_gtex)
) %>%
  filter(complete.cases(age_years, pred_anchored))

# TCGA-NAT
pred_nat <- clock_results$pred$NAT
age_nat  <- clock_results$age$NAT[names(pred_nat)]
ok_n     <- complete.cases(pred_nat, age_nat)
pred_nat <- pred_nat[ok_n]
age_nat  <- age_nat[ok_n]

nat_df <- tibble(
  cohort        = "TCGA-NAT",
  age_years     = as.numeric(age_nat),
  pred_anchored = as.numeric(pred_nat - beta0 + (1 - beta1) * age_nat)
) %>%
  filter(complete.cases(age_years, pred_anchored))

# TCGA-BRCA primary tumors
pred_pt_full <- clock_results$pred$Tumour
age_pt_full  <- clock_results$age$Tumour[names(pred_pt_full)]
ok_t         <- complete.cases(pred_pt_full, age_pt_full)
pred_pt_full <- pred_pt_full[ok_t]
age_pt_full  <- age_pt_full[ok_t]

pt_df <- tibble(
  cohort        = "TCGA-PT",
  age_years     = as.numeric(age_pt_full),
  pred_anchored = as.numeric(pred_pt_full - beta0 + (1 - beta1) * age_pt_full)
) %>%
  filter(complete.cases(age_years, pred_anchored))

# SCAN-B
scanb_df <- scanb_pred_df %>%
  transmute(
    cohort        = "SCAN-B",
    age_years,
    pred_anchored
  )

panelA_df <- bind_rows(gtex_df, nat_df, pt_df, scanb_df) %>%
  mutate(cohort = factor(cohort, levels = c("GTEx", "TCGA-NAT", "TCGA-PT", "SCAN-B")))

table(panelA_df$cohort)
```

```{r panelA-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
panelA_cols <- c(
  "GTEx"     = "#4daf4a",   # green
  "TCGA-NAT" = "darkgray",   # dark grey
  "TCGA-PT"  = "#7b3294",   # purple (matches the survival figure)
  "SCAN-B"   = "#fdae6b"    # orange
)

panelA_labels <- c(
  "GTEx"     = "GTEx-Breast",
  "TCGA-NAT" = "TCGA-BRCA NAT",
  "TCGA-PT"  = "TCGA-BRCA Tumor",
  "SCAN-B"   = "SCAN-B Tumor"
)

common_breaks <- c(0, 20, 40, 60, 80)

p_panelA <- ggplot(panelA_df, aes(x = age_years, y = pred_anchored, colour = cohort)) +
  geom_point(aes(alpha = cohort), size = 1.2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "black") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = panelA_cols, labels = panelA_labels) +
  scale_alpha_manual(
    values = c("GTEx" = 0.08, "TCGA-NAT" = 0.08, "TCGA-PT" = 0.08, "SCAN-B" = 0.04),
    guide  = "none"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = common_breaks) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = common_breaks) +
  labs(
    x = "Chronological age (years)",
    y = "Predicted Age (GTEx-Anchored, years)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 17) +
  theme(
    legend.title      = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major  = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks        = element_line(),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(2, "mm"),
    axis.title        = element_text(size = 17),
    axis.text         = element_text(size = 15),
    legend.text       = element_text(size = 15)
  )

p_panelA
```

```{r panelA-save}
if (isTRUE(params$save_figures)) {
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(out_dir, "anchored_age_4cohorts.pdf"),
    plot     = p_panelA,
    width    = 220 / 25.4,
    height   = 130 / 25.4,
    units    = "in"
  )
  message("Saved: ", file.path(out_dir, "anchored_age_4cohorts.pdf"))
}
```

# Age-matched deviation by cohort

Cohort-level summary of the GTEx-anchored age-matched deviation shown in the
anchored scatter, as boxplots, ordered GTEx-Breast → TCGA-BRCA adjacent normal
(NAT) → TCGA-BRCA primary tumors → SCAN-B primary tumors. GTEx sits at zero by
construction; the shift of each tumor cohort is the same deviation read off
vertically in the scatter. Colors match the scatter legend.

```{r panelB-build}
# Cohort-level age-matched deviations (same GTEx anchoring as the scatter)
dev_gtex_b  <- as.numeric(pred_gtex - (beta0 + beta1 * age_gtex))
dev_nat_b   <- if (!is.null(clockshap_bundle$nat)) {
  as.numeric(clockshap_bundle$nat$deviation)
} else {
  numeric(0)
}
dev_pt_b    <- as.numeric(cs_brca$deviation)
dev_scanb_b <- as.numeric(cs_scanb$deviation)

panelB_df <- bind_rows(
  tibble(cohort = "GTEx",     deviation = dev_gtex_b),
  tibble(cohort = "TCGA-NAT", deviation = dev_nat_b),
  tibble(cohort = "TCGA-PT",  deviation = dev_pt_b),
  tibble(cohort = "SCAN-B",   deviation = dev_scanb_b)
) %>%
  filter(is.finite(deviation)) %>%
  mutate(
    cohort = factor(cohort, levels = c("GTEx", "TCGA-NAT", "TCGA-PT", "SCAN-B")),
    tissue = "Breast"   # single facet level -> left strip matching the PAM50 panel
  )

table(panelB_df$cohort)
```

```{r panelB-kw}
# Shared p-value formatter (also used by the PAM50 panel)
fmt_p <- function(p) {
  if (!is.finite(p)) return("p = NA")
  if (p < 2.2e-16)   return("p < 2.2e-16")
  paste0("p = ", formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 2))
}

panelB_kw      <- suppressWarnings(
  kruskal.test(deviation ~ droplevels(cohort), data = panelB_df)$p.value
)
panelB_p_label <- paste0("Kruskal–Wallis ", fmt_p(panelB_kw))
panelB_p_label
```

```{r panelB-plot, fig.width=6, fig.height=3.5}
panelB_labels <- c(
  "GTEx"     = "GTEx-Breast",
  "TCGA-NAT" = "Adjacent Normal",
  "TCGA-PT"  = "TCGA-BRCA",
  "SCAN-B"   = "SCAN-B"
)

# p-value label at top-left of the panel (same convention as the PAM50 panel)
y_max_b   <- max(panelB_df$deviation, na.rm = TRUE)
y_min_b   <- min(panelB_df$deviation, na.rm = TRUE)
y_label_b <- y_max_b + 0.05 * (y_max_b - y_min_b)

panelB_pval_df <- tibble(
  tissue    = "Breast",
  deviation = y_label_b,
  p_label   = panelB_p_label
)

panelB_summary <- panelB_df %>%
  group_by(cohort) %>%
  summarise(
    n      = n(),
    mean   = round(mean(deviation), 2),
    median = round(median(deviation), 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(panelB_summary)

p_panelB <- ggplot(panelB_df, aes(x = cohort, y = deviation, fill = cohort)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.18, alpha = 0.18, size = 0.7, colour = "grey25") +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = panelA_cols, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = panelB_labels) +
  facet_grid(
    rows   = vars(tissue),
    switch = "y"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-60, NA)) +
  geom_text(
    data        = panelB_pval_df,
    aes(x = -Inf, y = deviation, label = p_label),
    hjust       = -0.05,
    vjust       = 1,
    size        = 3,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Age-matched deviation (years)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y       = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.x        = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 8),
    strip.text.y       = element_blank(),
    strip.background   = element_blank(),
    plot.margin        = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
  )

p_panelB
```

```{r panelB-save}
if (isTRUE(params$save_figures)) {
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(out_dir, "DevByCohort.pdf"),

    width    = 4,
    height   = 2.75,
    units    = "in"
  )
  message("Saved: ", file.path(out_dir, "DevByCohort.pdf"))
}
```

# ClockSHAP heatmaps (TCGA-BRCA + SCAN-B, shared scales)

Per-pathway ClockSHAP contributions across tumors, ordered within each cohort
by total age-matched deviation. Two heatmaps with **shared color scales,
shared annotation palettes, and a single set of legends + row labels** that
live on the TCGA-BRCA side. SCAN-B inherits BRCA's pathway row order from
hierarchical clustering, so rows align across cohorts and the TCGA row labels
visually carry over during manual figure assembly.

## Build matrices, row clustering, and shared color scales

```{r panelC-shared-build}
# ============================================================================
#   TCGA-BRCA matrix
# ============================================================================
phi_brca_full <- cs_brca$phi
dev_brca_full <- cs_brca$deviation
ids_brca_full <- rownames(phi_brca_full)

ok_b <- is.finite(dev_brca_full)
phi_brca_ok <- phi_brca_full[ok_b, , drop = FALSE]
dev_brca_ok <- dev_brca_full[ok_b]
ids_brca_ok <- ids_brca_full[ok_b]

ord_b <- order(dev_brca_ok, decreasing = FALSE)
phi_brca_ord <- phi_brca_ok[ord_b, , drop = FALSE]
dev_ord_brca <- dev_brca_ok[ord_b]
ids_ord_brca <- ids_brca_ok[ord_b]

mat_brca <- t(phi_brca_ord)
colnames(mat_brca) <- ids_ord_brca
mat_brca <- mat_brca[rowSums(abs(mat_brca), na.rm = TRUE) != 0, , drop = FALSE]
rownames(mat_brca)[rownames(mat_brca) == "Reactive Oxygen Species Pathway"] <- "ROS Pathway"

# Cluster on BRCA -- SCAN-B will inherit this ordering
hc_brca <- hclust(dist(mat_brca))
brca_row_order <- rownames(mat_brca)[hc_brca$order]

# ============================================================================
#   SCAN-B matrix (rows reordered to match BRCA)
# ============================================================================
phi_scanb_full <- cs_scanb$phi
dev_scanb_full <- cs_scanb$deviation
ids_scanb_full <- rownames(phi_scanb_full)

ok_s <- is.finite(dev_scanb_full)
phi_scanb_ok <- phi_scanb_full[ok_s, , drop = FALSE]
dev_scanb_ok <- dev_scanb_full[ok_s]
ids_scanb_ok <- ids_scanb_full[ok_s]

ord_s <- order(dev_scanb_ok, decreasing = FALSE)
phi_scanb_ord <- phi_scanb_ok[ord_s, , drop = FALSE]
dev_ord_scanb <- dev_scanb_ok[ord_s]
ids_ord_scanb <- ids_scanb_ok[ord_s]

mat_scanb <- t(phi_scanb_ord)
colnames(mat_scanb) <- ids_ord_scanb
mat_scanb <- mat_scanb[rowSums(abs(mat_scanb), na.rm = TRUE) != 0, , drop = FALSE]
rownames(mat_scanb)[rownames(mat_scanb) == "Reactive Oxygen Species Pathway"] <- "ROS Pathway"

# Inherit BRCA row order; intersect drops any pathway absent from SCAN-B
common_rows <- intersect(brca_row_order, rownames(mat_scanb))
n_dropped   <- length(setdiff(rownames(mat_scanb), common_rows))
n_added     <- length(setdiff(brca_row_order, common_rows))
mat_scanb   <- mat_scanb[common_rows, , drop = FALSE]
message(
  "Heatmap row alignment: ", length(common_rows), " pathways shared | ",
  n_dropped, " in SCAN-B but not in BRCA (dropped) | ",
  n_added,   " in BRCA but not in SCAN-B (skipped)."
)

# ============================================================================
#   Shared color scales (computed across BOTH cohorts)
# ============================================================================
# Deviation: across-cohort min / 0 / max
dev_col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(
  c(min(c(dev_ord_brca, dev_ord_scanb), na.rm = TRUE),
    0,
    max(c(dev_ord_brca, dev_ord_scanb), na.rm = TRUE)),
  c("darkblue", "white", "darkred")
)

# Phi: 99th percentile of |phi| across both matrices, symmetric ramp
phi_lim <- as.numeric(stats::quantile(
  c(abs(mat_brca), abs(mat_scanb)),
  probs = 0.99, na.rm = TRUE
))
phi_lim <- max(phi_lim, 1e-6)

phi_col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(
  c(-phi_lim, 0, phi_lim),
  c("steelblue", "white", "firebrick")
)

# ============================================================================
#   Shared annotation palettes (superset across cohorts so legend covers both)
# ============================================================================
pam_cols_shared <- c(
  Basal         = "#d73027",
  Her2          = "#fc8d59",
  LumA          = "#4575b4",
  LumB          = "#91bfdb",
  `Normal-Like` = "#cccccc",
  Unclassified  = "grey70"      # SCAN-B only; absent in TCGA but in legend
)
tp53_cols_shared <- c(WT = "grey85", Mut = "black", Unknown = "white")

pam_levels_full  <- names(pam_cols_shared)
tp53_levels_full <- names(tp53_cols_shared)

# ---- TCGA-BRCA annotation vectors as factors with full level set ----
pam_brca <- as.character(metadata[ids_ord_brca, "Subtype_Selected"])
pam_brca <- dplyr::recode(pam_brca, "Normal" = "Normal-Like")
pam_brca <- factor(pam_brca, levels = pam_levels_full)

tp53_brca <- as.character(metadata[ids_ord_brca, "TP53"])
tp53_brca[is.na(tp53_brca) | tp53_brca == ""] <- "Unknown"
tp53_brca <- factor(tp53_brca, levels = tp53_levels_full)

# ---- SCAN-B annotation vectors as factors with full level set ----
pam_scanb <- as.character(scanb_coldata[ids_ord_scanb, "SSP.PAM50"])
pam_scanb[is.na(pam_scanb) | pam_scanb == ""] <- "Unclassified"
pam_scanb <- dplyr::recode(pam_scanb, "Normal" = "Normal-Like")
pam_scanb <- factor(pam_scanb, levels = pam_levels_full)

tp53_scanb <- if ("TP53" %in% colnames(scanb_coldata)) {
  as.character(scanb_coldata[ids_ord_scanb, "TP53"])
} else {
  rep(NA_character_, length(ids_ord_scanb))
}
tp53_scanb[is.na(tp53_scanb) | tp53_scanb == ""] <- "Unknown"
tp53_scanb <- factor(tp53_scanb, levels = tp53_levels_full)
```

# PAM50 deviation by cohort

Statistical anchor for the PAM50 annotation strip in the heatmaps. Two facets on
a shared deviation y-axis: TCGA-BRCA (with Adjacent Normal as leftmost
reference) and SCAN-B. PAM50 ordering is fixed left-to-right by canonical
aggressiveness convention (Normal-Like → LumA → LumB → Her2 → Basal). The
Kruskal–Wallis omnibus tests whether tumor subtypes differ from each other
(NAT excluded — tumors vs normal is visually obvious and not the question).

## Build long-form data

```{r panelD-build}
# ---- TCGA-BRCA: PAM50 by deviation ----
ids_brca   <- rownames(cs_brca$phi)
dev_brca_d <- cs_brca$deviation

pam50_brca <- as.character(metadata[ids_brca, "Subtype_Selected"])
pam50_brca[is.na(pam50_brca) | pam50_brca == ""] <- NA_character_
pam50_brca <- dplyr::recode(pam50_brca, "Normal" = "Normal-Like")

# ---- TCGA-BRCA Adjacent Normal (NAT): leftmost reference ----
# Pulled from the saved ClockSHAP bundle. NAT is shown as anchor
# only -- it is NOT included in the KW omnibus across tumor subtypes.
dev_nat_d <- if (!is.null(clockshap_bundle$nat)) {
  as.numeric(clockshap_bundle$nat$deviation)
} else {
  numeric(0)
}
message("TCGA-BRCA NAT samples for the PAM50 panel anchor: ", length(dev_nat_d))

# ---- SCAN-B: PAM50 by deviation ----
ids_scanb   <- rownames(cs_scanb$phi)
dev_scanb_d <- cs_scanb$deviation

pam50_scanb <- as.character(scanb_coldata[ids_scanb, "SSP.PAM50"])
pam50_scanb[is.na(pam50_scanb) | pam50_scanb == ""] <- NA_character_
pam50_scanb <- dplyr::recode(pam50_scanb, "Normal" = "Normal-Like")

# ---- Long-form for ggplot ----
pam50_levels <- c("Adjacent Normal", "Normal-Like", "LumA", "LumB", "Her2", "Basal")

panelD_df <- bind_rows(
  # NAT (TCGA only, leftmost reference)
  if (length(dev_nat_d) > 0) {
    tibble(
      cohort    = "TCGA-BRCA",
      group     = "Adjacent Normal",
      deviation = dev_nat_d
    )
  } else {
    tibble(cohort = character(), group = character(), deviation = numeric())
  },
  tibble(
    cohort    = "TCGA-BRCA",
    group     = pam50_brca,
    deviation = as.numeric(dev_brca_d)
  ),
  tibble(
    cohort    = "SCAN-B",
    group     = pam50_scanb,
    deviation = as.numeric(dev_scanb_d)
  )
) %>%
  filter(group %in% pam50_levels, is.finite(deviation)) %>%
  mutate(
    cohort = factor(cohort, levels = c("TCGA-BRCA", "SCAN-B")),
    group  = factor(group, levels = pam50_levels)
  )

panelD_df %>%
  count(cohort, group) %>%
  arrange(cohort, group)

panelD_summary <- panelD_df %>%
  group_by(cohort, group) %>%
  summarise(
    n      = n(),
    mean   = round(mean(deviation), 2),
    median = round(median(deviation), 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(panelD_summary, n = Inf)
```

## Kruskal–Wallis omnibus tests (per cohort, NAT excluded)

```{r panelD-tests}
fmt_p <- function(p) {
  if (!is.finite(p)) return("p = NA")
  if (p < 2.2e-16)   return("p < 2.2e-16")
  paste0("p = ", formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 2))
}

panelD_pvals <- panelD_df %>%
  filter(group != "Adjacent Normal") %>%      # tumor subtypes only
  group_by(cohort) %>%
  group_modify(~ tibble(
    p_value = suppressWarnings(
      kruskal.test(deviation ~ droplevels(group), data = .x)$p.value
    )
  )) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(p_label = paste0("Kruskal–Wallis ", fmt_p(p_value))) %>%
  ungroup()

panelD_pvals
```

# TP53 mutation class and P53 Pathway φ

TP53-mutant tumors have lower age-matched deviation than TP53 wild-type tumors,
but the comparison is confounded: TP53 mutations enrich in aggressive PAM50
subtypes (Basal, Her2), so TP53-Mut tumors look younger in part because they
ARE Basal/Her2, not because of an independent TP53 contribution. This panel
dissects the TP53 effect mechanistically by (a) classifying mutations by
predicted functional consequence and (b) testing them against the
ClockSHAP-resolved **P53 Pathway φ** — the gene-set readout most directly
connected to TP53 transcription factor activity.

**TP53 classes (three categories):**

- **WT** — no TP53 mutation
- **Missense** — single amino acid substitution; functionally heterogeneous
  (some retain activity, some lose it, some change it)
- **Truncating** — nonsense, frameshift, or splice site; produces a
  prematurely terminated protein, an unambiguous loss of function

The cleanest functional contrast is **Truncating vs WT**, with Missense
included as a "mutated but not clearly LOF" comparison group.

**Modeling strategy**:

- **One model per cohort** `p53_phi ~ TP53_3way + PAM50`, each with its
  own residual variance, so each cohort's estimates, intervals, and
  p-values depend only on its own data. The residual SD differs between
  cohorts, so a single joint model would misstate both cohorts'
  uncertainty.
- **Cohort comparison** by a Wald test (2 df) on the difference of the
  cohort-specific TP53 coefficients, using each cohort's own covariance.
- Adjust for PAM50 throughout (the dominant source of variation in P53 φ).
- Restrict to the five tumor PAM50 subtypes (Normal-Like, LumA, LumB, Her2,
  Basal); adjacent normal is excluded.
- TCGA-BRCA is analysed per patient: patients with several tumor profiles
  are represented once, by the mean of their P53 φ, so that replicate
  profiles of one tumor are not counted as independent tumors.

The Wald test asks whether the TP53 effect differs between cohorts. It does
(TCGA-BRCA larger than SCAN-B), so cohort-specific estimates are reported
and no pooled estimate is shown. Pairwise contrasts (each TP53 class vs WT)
come out via `contrast()` with Dunnett adjustment within each cohort.

## TP53 mutation classifier

Unified classifier that handles both TCGA-BRCA (cBioPortal MAF, `Mutation
Type` field) and SCAN-B (Brueffer 2020, `SnpEff.Effect.Class` field) by
their mutation-type label. When a sample has multiple TP53 mutations, the
highest-impact class wins (Truncating > Missense).

```{r panelE-classifier}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(emmeans)
  library(broom)
  library(ggpubr)        # stat_pvalue_manual
})

classify_mutation <- function(mutation_type) {
  trunc_classes <- c(
    "Nonsense_Mutation","Frame_Shift_Del","Frame_Shift_Ins","Splice_Site",  # MAF
    "Nonsense","Frameshift","Splicing"                                       # SnpEff
  )
  miss_classes <- c("Missense_Mutation","Missense")
  if (is.na(mutation_type)) return(NA_character_)
  if (mutation_type %in% trunc_classes) return("Truncating")
  if (mutation_type %in% miss_classes)  return("Missense")
  "Other_Mut"   # in-frame indels, splice region, etc. — dropped from analysis
}

aggregate_sample_class <- function(per_mut_classes) {
  per_mut_classes <- per_mut_classes[!is.na(per_mut_classes)]
  if (length(per_mut_classes) == 0)         return(NA_character_)
  if (any(per_mut_classes == "Truncating")) return("Truncating")
  if (any(per_mut_classes == "Missense"))   return("Missense")
  if (any(per_mut_classes == "Other_Mut"))  return("Other_Mut")
  NA_character_
}
```

## Classify TCGA-BRCA (cBioPortal MAF)

Reads the cBioPortal TP53 mutation table, classifies each mutation,
aggregates per patient barcode (12-char). The TCGA pipeline indexes samples
by UUID, so we bridge cBioPortal patient barcodes → pipeline UUIDs via
`metadata$tcga.tcga_barcode`. Samples not in the mutation table are coded WT.

```{r panelE-tcga-classify}
tcga_tp53_tsv <- "/restricted/projectnb/agedisease/projects/pancancer_aging_pbock/manuscript_analyses/data/metadata/cBioPortal_TP53-BRCA_table.tsv"
stopifnot(file.exists(tcga_tp53_tsv))

tcga_tp53 <- readr::read_tsv(tcga_tp53_tsv, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Per-sample class from cBioPortal table
tcga_class_per_sample <- tcga_tp53 %>%
  dplyr::filter(Gene == "TP53") %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    barcode12 = substr(`Sample ID`, 1, 12),
    mut_type  = `Mutation Type`
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(per_mut_class = classify_mutation(mut_type)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::group_by(barcode12) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(class = aggregate_sample_class(per_mut_class), .groups = "drop")

# Bridge: pipeline UUIDs → patient barcode-12
brca_ids <- rownames(cs_brca$phi)
stopifnot("tcga.tcga_barcode" %in% colnames(metadata))

uuid2bar12    <- setNames(substr(metadata[brca_ids, "tcga.tcga_barcode"], 1, 12), brca_ids)
uuid2bar12    <- uuid2bar12[!is.na(uuid2bar12) & uuid2bar12 != ""]

# Default to WT, overwrite mutated samples. Joined on barcode-12 so that every
# profile of a patient with several profiles receives that patient's class.
tp53_class_tcga <- rep("WT", length(brca_ids))
names(tp53_class_tcga) <- brca_ids
class_by_uuid <- tcga_class_per_sample$class[match(uuid2bar12, tcga_class_per_sample$barcode12)]
keep_tcga     <- !is.na(class_by_uuid)
tp53_class_tcga[names(uuid2bar12)[keep_tcga]] <- class_by_uuid[keep_tcga]

cat("TCGA-BRCA TP53 class distribution:\n")
print(table(tp53_class_tcga, useNA = "ifany"))
cat("Bridge: ", sum(tcga_class_per_sample$barcode12 %in% uuid2bar12), " / ", nrow(tcga_class_per_sample),
    " mutated barcodes mapped into cohort UUIDs\n", sep = "")
```

## Classify SCAN-B (Brueffer 2020 SnpEff)

Same classifier applied to SCAN-B's SnpEff effect classes (Nonsense /
Frameshift / Splicing → Truncating; Missense → Missense). Samples that
appear in the Brueffer 2020 cohort but lack a TP53 entry are coded WT;
samples outside the cohort of 3,217 are left NA.

```{r panelE-scanb-classify}
scanb_mut <- readr::read_tsv(params$scanb_tp53_tsv, comment = "##", show_col_types = FALSE)
stopifnot(all(c("SAMPLE","gene.symbol","SnpEff.Effect.Class") %in% colnames(scanb_mut)))

scanb_class_per_sample <- scanb_mut %>%
  dplyr::filter(gene.symbol == "TP53") %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    sample_match = SAMPLE,
    mut_type     = SnpEff.Effect.Class
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(per_mut_class = classify_mutation(mut_type)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample_match) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(class = aggregate_sample_class(per_mut_class), .groups = "drop")

scanb_ids        <- rownames(cs_scanb$phi)
scanb_ids_match  <- sub("\\.k2\\.a\\.t$", "", scanb_ids)
cohort_ids_scanb <- unique(scanb_mut$SAMPLE)

tp53_class_scanb <- rep(NA_character_, length(scanb_ids))
names(tp53_class_scanb) <- scanb_ids
in_cohort <- scanb_ids_match %in% cohort_ids_scanb
tp53_class_scanb[in_cohort] <- "WT"

match_idx  <- match(scanb_class_per_sample$sample_match, scanb_ids_match)
keep_scanb <- !is.na(match_idx)
tp53_class_scanb[match_idx[keep_scanb]] <- scanb_class_per_sample$class[keep_scanb]

cat("\nSCAN-B TP53 class distribution:\n")
print(table(tp53_class_scanb, useNA = "ifany"))
cat("Match: ", sum(keep_scanb), " / ", nrow(scanb_class_per_sample),
    " mutated samples mapped to cohort\n", sep = "")
```

## Build the analysis tibble with P53 Pathway φ

Pull both cohorts into one tibble (TCGA-BRCA collapsed to one row per
patient). Restrict to the five tumor PAM50 subtypes and to the three TP53
classes of interest. `Other_Mut` (in-frame
indels, splice region) is dropped — small n, ambiguous functional
consequence.

```{r panelE-build}
find_p53_col <- function(phi_mat) {
  cands <- c("P53 Pathway","P53 pathway","P53_Pathway")
  hit <- intersect(cands, colnames(phi_mat))[1]
  if (is.na(hit)) {
    idx <- grep("p53.*pathway", colnames(phi_mat), ignore.case = TRUE)
    stopifnot(length(idx) >= 1)
    hit <- colnames(phi_mat)[idx[1]]
  }
  hit
}
p53_col_b <- find_p53_col(cs_brca$phi)
p53_col_s <- find_p53_col(cs_scanb$phi)

clean_pam <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x); x[is.na(x) | x == "" | x == "NC"] <- NA_character_
  dplyr::recode(x, "Normal" = "Normal-Like")
}

# TCGA-BRCA: one row per patient. A few patients have several tumor profiles
# (up to five vials of one tumor) and fall into the small mutation classes;
# averaging their P53 phi avoids counting one tumor several times in the test.
tcga_patient_df <- tibble(
  cohort     = "TCGA-BRCA",
  sample_id  = brca_ids,
  patient12  = unname(uuid2bar12[brca_ids]),
  PAM50      = clean_pam(metadata[brca_ids, "Subtype_Selected"]),
  TP53_class = tp53_class_tcga[brca_ids],
  p53_phi    = as.numeric(cs_brca$phi[, p53_col_b])
) %>%
  group_by(cohort, patient12, PAM50, TP53_class) %>%
  summarise(p53_phi = mean(p53_phi), .groups = "drop") %>%
  rename(sample_id = patient12)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(tcga_patient_df$sample_id))   # PAM50 and TP53 class are constant within patient

driver_df <- bind_rows(
  tcga_patient_df,
  tibble(
    cohort     = "SCAN-B",
    sample_id  = scanb_ids,
    PAM50      = clean_pam(scanb_coldata[scanb_ids, "SSP.PAM50"]),
    TP53_class = tp53_class_scanb[scanb_ids],
    p53_phi    = as.numeric(cs_scanb$phi[, p53_col_s])
  )
) %>%
  filter(
    PAM50 %in% c("Normal-Like","LumA","LumB","Her2","Basal"),           #  tumor subtypes
    TP53_class %in% c("WT","Truncating","Missense"),      # 3-way classification
    is.finite(p53_phi)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cohort    = factor(cohort, levels = c("TCGA-BRCA","SCAN-B")),
    PAM50     = factor(PAM50,  levels = c("Normal-Like","LumA","LumB","Her2","Basal")),
    TP53_3way = factor(TP53_class, levels = c("WT","Missense","Truncating"))
  )

cat("\nSample sizes per cohort × PAM50 × TP53 class:\n")
print(
  driver_df %>%
    count(cohort, PAM50, TP53_3way) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = TP53_3way, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
    arrange(cohort, PAM50),
  n = Inf
)
``` 

## Fit models, test interaction, compute emmeans + contrasts

One model per cohort, `p53_phi ~ TP53_3way + PAM50`, each with its own
residual variance, so each cohort's estimates, intervals, and p-values
depend only on its own data (the residual SD differs between cohorts, so a
single joint model would misstate both cohorts' uncertainty). Whether the
TP53 effect differs between cohorts is tested by a Wald test on the
difference of the cohort-specific TP53 coefficients (2 df), reported in the
text.

```{r panelE-models}
# One model per cohort, each with its own residual variance
fit_by_cohort <- lapply(split(driver_df, driver_df$cohort), function(d) {
  lm(p53_phi ~ TP53_3way + PAM50, data = d)
})
cat("Residual SD per cohort:\n")
print(sapply(fit_by_cohort, sigma))

# Does the TP53 effect differ between cohorts? Wald test on the coefficient
# difference, using each cohort's own covariance (reported in the text)
tp53_terms <- c("TP53_3wayMissense", "TP53_3wayTruncating")
b_diff <- coef(fit_by_cohort[["TCGA-BRCA"]])[tp53_terms] - coef(fit_by_cohort[["SCAN-B"]])[tp53_terms]
V_diff <- vcov(fit_by_cohort[["TCGA-BRCA"]])[tp53_terms, tp53_terms] +
          vcov(fit_by_cohort[["SCAN-B"]])[tp53_terms, tp53_terms]
wald_stat <- as.numeric(t(b_diff) %*% solve(V_diff) %*% b_diff)
wald_p    <- stats::pchisq(wald_stat, df = 2, lower.tail = FALSE)
cat("\nTP53 class × cohort (Wald, 2 df): chi-square = ", round(wald_stat, 2),
    ", p = ", signif(wald_p, 3), "\n", sep = "")
cat("Cohort difference in TP53 coefficients (TCGA-BRCA minus SCAN-B), years:\n")
print(round(cbind(difference = b_diff, SE = sqrt(diag(V_diff))), 3))

# Emmeans per cohort
emm_by_cohort <- lapply(fit_by_cohort, function(f) emmeans(f, ~ TP53_3way))
```


```{r}
# Helper: strip emmeans summary attributes that break tibble printing
clean_emm <- function(x) {
  df <- as.data.frame(x)
  for (a in c("mesg","pri.info","estName","clNames","by.vars","famSize")) {
    attr(df, a) <- NULL
  }
  tibble::as_tibble(df)
}

contrasts_strat_df <- bind_rows(lapply(names(emm_by_cohort), function(ch) {
  clean_emm(summary(
    contrast(emm_by_cohort[[ch]], method = "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = "WT", adjust = "dunnettx"),
    infer = TRUE
  )) %>% mutate(cohort = ch, panel = ch)
}))

contrasts_df <- contrasts_strat_df %>%
  mutate(
    panel     = factor(panel, levels = c("TCGA-BRCA","SCAN-B")),
    TP53_3way = sub(" - WT$", "", contrast),
    p_label   = case_when(
      is.na(p.value)  ~ NA_character_,
      p.value < 0.001 ~ "p < 0.001",
      TRUE            ~ paste0("p = ", sprintf("%.3f", p.value))
    )
  )

cat("\nPer-panel contrasts (each TP53 class vs WT, Dunnett-adjusted):\n")
print(
  contrasts_df %>%
    dplyr::select(panel, contrast, estimate, lower.CL, upper.CL, p.value, p_label),
  n = Inf
)
```

## Plot

Adjusted P53 Pathway φ at each TP53 class × cohort cell. Significance
brackets show Dunnett-adjusted contrasts (each TP53 class vs WT).

```{r panelE-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
emm_strat_df <- bind_rows(lapply(names(emm_by_cohort), function(ch) {
  as.data.frame(confint(emm_by_cohort[[ch]])) %>% mutate(cohort = ch, panel = ch)
}))

emm_plot_df <- emm_strat_df %>%
  mutate(panel = factor(panel, levels = c("TCGA-BRCA","SCAN-B")))

knitr::kable(emm_plot_df, digits = 2,
             caption = "PAM50-adjusted P53 Pathway phi (emmean and 95% CI) per TP53 class and cohort, as plotted.")

# Color by cohort (replaces the per-class palette)
cohort_pal <- c(
  "TCGA-BRCA" = "#7b3294",   # purple, matches OS figure
  "SCAN-B"    = "#e66101"    # orange, matches OS figure
)

# Position significance brackets above CI tops, staggered per panel
y_top <- emm_plot_df %>%
  group_by(panel) %>%
  summarise(
    ci_top  = max(upper.CL, na.rm = TRUE),
    ci_span = max(upper.CL, na.rm = TRUE) - min(lower.CL, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

annot_df <- contrasts_df %>%
  left_join(y_top, by = "panel") %>%
  group_by(panel) %>%
  mutate(
    y.position = ci_top + ci_span * (0.10 + 0.18 * (row_number() - 1)),
    group1 = "WT",
    group2 = TP53_3way
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

p_panelE <- ggplot(emm_plot_df, aes(x = TP53_3way, y = emmean, colour = panel)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL),
                width = 0.15, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cohort_pal, guide = "none") +
  ggpubr::stat_pvalue_manual(
    annot_df,
    label       = "p_label",
    xmin        = "group1",
    xmax        = "group2",
    y.position  = "y.position",
    tip.length  = 0.01,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ panel, nrow = 1) +
  labs(
    x = "TP53 mutation class",
    y = "Emmean P53 Pathway Dev. (years, PAM50 adj.)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    strip.text         = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    strip.background   = element_rect(fill = "grey95", colour = NA),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 8)
  )

p_panelE
```

```{r panelE-save}
if (isTRUE(params$save_figures)) {
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(out_dir, "TP53class_P53phi_EMM.pdf"),
    plot     = p_panelE,
    width    = 3.25,
    height   = 3.75,
    units    = "in"
  )
  message("Saved: ", file.path(out_dir, "TP53class_P53phi_EMM.pdf"))
}
```
